title: Chapter 415: It Seems Like A World Away
content:
Chapter 415: It Seems Like A World Away

There is a problem, it's too problematic.

If you take her away, how can my Heavenly Demon Clan gather all the four symbols of Heavenly Demon Clan, and how can we make the Heavenly Demon Clan create new glory?

But, he dared not say it.

"Senior Lu, it seems a bit bad for you to take me, a member of the Heavenly Demon tribe like this."

The patriarch of the Tian Yao clan's tone was extremely humble, but he still had the courage to keep Bai Ling.

But Lu Xue always had a cold face.

"This is her own choice. If you have the ability, you can also let her choose to stay."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan was stunned and reacted.

Immediately, he said sincerely to Bai Ling beside Lu Xue: "Child, you are from my Tian Yao tribe. Only by staying in the Tian Yao tribe can you have a brilliant future."

"I promise you that as long as you stay, my Tian Yao Clan will do its best to cultivate it."

Looking at the sincerity of the Heavenly Demon Clan leader, Bai Ling blinked, not looking at Lu Xue or Ao Qing. She bowed slightly to the Heavenly Demon Clan leader and said apologetically: "Sorry, Master, I have already I decided to follow Senior Lu Xue and Lord Ao Qing."

Hearing this, the patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan looked ugly and was disappointed, but he didn't dare to say anything.

But Bai Ling's next sentence made him see some hope.

Bai Ling continued, "If the Heavenly Demon Clan is in trouble in the future, Bai Ling will not stand by and watch."

After saying that, Bai Lingyu Guang secretly glanced at Lu Xue and saw that Lu Xue had no reaction, he felt a little relieved.

The leader of the Tian Yao tribe laughed.

I'd said it earlier, I'd be relieved if I had you.

"Since that's the case, then you'll have the chance to see you again."

"Grandmaster said goodbye."

After Lu Xue and others left, the leader of the Tian Yao clan also called two young monsters in the clan.

"Qinghai, Xuansi, I'll give you two a task."

Two young demons named Qinghai and Xuansi respectfully clasped their fists, "Please give me instructions, please."

The head of the Tiande Clan looked into the sky and his eyes became deeper.

"Finding the White Tiger, whether it is the end of the world or the corner of the sea, I believe that you two will definitely reappear in this era."

"And that time was also the time when my Heavenly Demon Clan rose again!"

"Yes, Master Clan!"

Many years later.

After years of stable development, the Tian Yao Clan has gradually recovered some energy.

After eliminating the hidden danger of the Wu family and recuperating, the human race has also improved its strength.

The deserted city.

On this day, two familiar figures appeared in front of the gate of Huangcheng City.

"Ah, I'm back, it's really like a different life."

Looking at the giant city that was so close to you, the old man Broken Sword sighed and had not taken a step for a long time.

Lu Xue stood beside her, smiling.

"It's true that I haven't been back for a long time."

At this time, the two strong men guarding the city gate also noticed Lu Xue and the others.

“That’s,

"Miss, Miss Lu Xue!!"

The moment he recognized Lu Xue, the two city guards rushed to Lu Xue as if teleported, and then saluted respectfully.

"I welcome Miss Lu Xue back!"

The two of them could not hide their excitement.

Lu Xue raised her jade hand lightly, and a gentle force lifted the two of them up.

"Get up, don't be too polite."

"Thank you Miss Luxue!"

The two city guards all have the aura of the Supreme Heaven.

The Supreme Heaven, who is dominating the storm of the Chaos Realm and calling the wind and rain, is only a guardian in the deserted city.

This is also the reason why Huangcheng is known as the holy land of the entire Chaos Realm.

The energy is too great.

Not the same level at all.

Soon, the two entered the city.

The prosperous scene comes into view. Over the years, as the space of the deserted city becomes larger and larger, the outer city is also expanding again and again, but even so, the high land prices are still difficult for most people to reach.

“There are quite a change.”

The old man Broken Sword glanced at him and commented.

Lu Xue nodded slightly.

After a moment of silence, the old man Broken Sword smiled and said, "Miss Lu Xue, it's time to part."

He is going to meet those old friends, too.

"Goodbye."

Lu Xue didn't say much, and the two soon parted ways.

After many years, the deserted city has changed a lot or not.

But there are many familiar people in the city.

Those people obviously haven't returned yet.

Just then, two familiar voices sounded from a distance.

Lu Xue looked back and saw a man and a woman, one tall and one short, walking towards him with a smile on her face.

"Sister Xue, your separation has been so long."

The person who comes is the moon and purity.

"Sister Lu Xue, you are back. It's so boring here."

Jing opened her big watery eyes and hugged Lu Xue with some grievance.

Lu Xue also acted as the eldest sister for the guys thrown back by these two fathers.

Gently stroked Jing's head, Lu Xue said gently: "Xiaojing, didn't you say you were asked to supervise Brother Yueming's practice? You won't be playing all the time, right?"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Jing blinked and hurriedly buried her little face on Lu Xue's body.

"No, Sister Lu Xue, don't be wronged!"

On the side, Yueming said awkwardly, "Sister Xue, I have been working very hard, okay?"

He has made rapid progress over the years with the resources in the deserted city.

Now his strength has reached the peak of the entire Chaos Realm.

He is also worthy of being a genius that Lu Daosheng likes.

But just this is the case, it is far from enough for him to fight against the land of the gods.

Looking at Yue Ming's explanation, Lu Xue nodded with a smile.

Yueming was silent for a moment, and suddenly asked, "Sister Xue, when will Senior Lu come back?"

"Um?"

Lu Xue was slightly stunned and looked at Yueming.

Yueming hesitated for a while and said, "I want to go back to the Yue tribe."

Recently, for some reason, he always felt that something in the Moon Clan would help him a lot.

Hearing this, Lu Xue pondered for a moment and said, "There are indeed magical objects that can be teleported remotely in the wasteland city. As long as you can describe the specific image in your mind, you can teleport you there."

"only,,"

Lu Xue's words made Yue Ming's expression lit up, "What are you waiting for?"

Looking at Yue Ming who was a little excited, Lu Xue sighed slightly, "That thing can only be sent to you, but not to you."

"If you want to come back, you can only rely on yourself."

"So, you choose it yourself."

Yueming frowned and pondered for a long time, but finally decided to take a gamble.

......

"Really ready? Are you sure you don't think about it anymore?"

"I can't come back anymore, so I can only wait for my dad to come back before picking you up."

Lu Xue stood aside and asked finally.

Upon hearing this, Yueming looked firm, "Come on, Sister Xue, I'm ready. There is no need for Senior Lu to take action. If I can't come back, it means I'm just like that."

"Who is my Yueming? I am the one who will definitely defeat the land of the gods in the future. In the future, my Yueming's name will definitely be,,,"

Before Yue Ming could finish his words, Lu Xue quickly activated the teleportation object.

As Yueming's figure began to blur, Yueming quickly shut up and outlined the appearance of the Yue clan in his mind.

The next moment, a light flashed.

Yueming disappeared from the spot.

"Huh, I'm finally leaving, it's so long-winded."
